cases.name: Verify Form Social Field Configuration with Auto-Complete URL Generation and Cross-Channel Display
cases.module: My Shop / Storefront / Edit Profile / Storefront / Contact us form
cases.condition:
Merchant is logged in and navigated to the "Customize shop" page
Phase I implementation is active (Instagram only; TikTok/YouTube support pending Phase II)
cases.desc: KAT-10552

steps.desc: Field Configuration: Click "Add new field" → Select "Social" → Verify "Social platform" dropdown defaults to "Instagram" (only option in Phase I) → Enter custom Title (e.g., "Find us on Instagram") → Check "Required" → Click "Add" to save
steps.result: Configuration side: Social field is created successfully; platform dropdown locks to Instagram for Phase I; Title field accepts custom input; field displays in form builder with correct iconography

steps.desc: End-User Handle Input (Short Format): Access the form as consumer → Verify Instagram icon displays with placeholder "@Instagram username" → Enter handle abc123 (plain alphanumeric) → Submit form
steps.result: Short format handling: Submission details displays @abc123 as blue, underlined hyperlink; clicking navigates to https://www.instagram.com/abc123 (system auto-completes domain)

steps.desc: End-User Handle Input (With @ Symbol): Access form again → Enter @iamsupermush (with @ prefix) → Submit form
steps.result: @ symbol handling: System strips the @ prefix automatically; displays as @iamsupermush but links to https://www.instagram.com/iamsupermush (normalized format)

steps.desc: End-User Handle Input (Full URL): Access form → Enter https://www.instagram.com/xyz_789 → Submit form
steps.result: Full URL handling: System parses handle xyz_789 from full URL; displays as @xyz_789 linking to https://www.instagram.com/xyz_789 (or maintains original URL per product spec)

steps.desc: Data Display Verification: Navigate to "Customer submissions" → Open Submission details for each of the three submissions → Click the Instagram handle link
steps.result: Cross-channel consistency: 1.Submission details: Blue highlighted, clickable text with cursor:pointer; opens in new tab 2.Email notification: Renders as HTML hyperlink @xxx in blue; clickable in email clients 3.Excel export: Cell contains hyperlinked formula (e.g., =HYPERLINK("https://www.instagram.com/xxx","@xxx")) appearing as blue, clickable text

cases.name: Verify Form Social Field Input Format Validation (Without Existence Checking)
cases.module: My Shop / Storefront / Edit Profile / Storefront / Contact us form
cases.condition:
Form contains a required Social field configured for Instagram
Merchant has published the form and provided the consumer-facing URL

steps.desc: Empty Field Validation: Open form as consumer → Leave Instagram field blank → Click "Submit"
steps.result: Empty submission: Submission is blocked; inline validation displays "This field is required" with red border styling consistent with other required fields (Email, Phone)

steps.desc: Valid Character Verification: Enter handle using allowed Instagram characters: user_name.123 (letters, numbers, underscores, periods) → Submit successfully
steps.result: Valid characters: Form accepts submission; handle displays correctly across all merchant touchpoints (dashboard, email, export)

steps.desc: Invalid Character - Space: Enter user name (containing space) → Attempt to submit
steps.result: Spaces: Input is rejected with message "Username can only contain letters, numbers, periods, and underscores" (or frontend input mask prevents space entry entirely)

steps.desc: Invalid Character - Special Symbols: Enter user#name or user@name (containing # or middle @) → Attempt to submit
steps.result: Special symbols: Input is rejected; system enforces Instagram username rules strictly—only alphanumeric characters, periods, and underscores are permitted; special characters trigger validation error

steps.desc: Format vs Existence Verification: Enter a syntactically valid but potentially non-existent handle (e.g., nonexistent_user_99999) → Submit and verify system accepts it without "User not found" errors
steps.result: No existence validation: System performs format validation only; does not verify if the Instagram account actually exists. Validly formatted handles (even fictitious ones) generate clickable blue links that may lead to Instagram's "Page Not Found" when clicked, but this is acceptable per requirements
